spec.headline: Scrolling for messages vs. a clean enquiry log

alts: Here is how an automated WhatsApp enquiry log works

Slide 2 of 7: Searching through messy chat histories hides customer details when you need them. When customer messages pile up daily, names, numbers, and requests get buried. Scrolling back manually wastes time and makes it harder to follow up quickly.

Slide 3 of 7: The chatbot answers common questions and extracts enquiry details in the background. Customers chat naturally on WhatsApp. As the bot answers common questions, it identifies their name, contact info, and exact requirement without extra forms.

Slide 4 of 7: Integration logic: routing messy chat text into structured data rows. Flow: WhatsApp incoming webhook -> Parse payload -> Extract {name, phone, requirement} -> POST to Google Sheets API -> Trigger notification for your team.

Slide 5 of 7: A clean enquiry log helps you follow up without scrolling fatigue. You check one organized table instead of hundreds of chat threads. Every lead is visible in one place, making faster responses much easier.
Slide 6 of 7: how AI chatbot development works. DM BOT to enquire.
Slide 7 of 7: DM BOT. DM if this fits your workflow. We can discuss whether an automated lead log fits your daily business communication.
